notes.title: Trial Version Update Ver1.0.1
notes.content:
February 28, 2025 – Trial Version Update

We have made the following updates to the trial version:

- Added a jingle to the defeat animation.
- Displayed an alert when a large amount of coins are left unused.
- Fixed an issue where a player could be defeated by damage from other enemies while delivering a finishing blow to a boss using a multi-hit special move.
- Changed the specifications so that the effects of the three-choice treasure chests in the main trial version do not apply in the Gamer Ability Test.
- Changed the specifications so that skill effects from the main trial version do not apply in the Gamer Ability Test.
- Fixed a bug where selecting a hint after defeat in the Gamer Ability Test would display an error message.
- Other minor fixes.

As part of the defeat animation, it was sometimes unclear whether the player had won or lost when all hearts were depleted. To improve clarity, we have added a slightly disappointing sound effect upon defeat.
Additionally, to help players notice when they have an excessive number of coins left, an alert will now be displayed when the number of unused coins exceeds a certain threshold.

That's all for this update!



Bonus: Developer’s Message
Thank you to everyone who has played the trial version!
The Gamer Ability Test has received great feedback, and we've even had requests to include it in the full game.
As we move toward release, we will continue refining the game to make it more enjoyable and memorable. We appreciate your continued interest!

It will take some more time before the official release, so please enjoy the many wonderful games out there while you wait.

notes.title: Demo Version Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]- Demo Version Now Available[/h2]
The demo version of The Beast and the Princess is now available starting today, February 21st!

You can experience about 30 minutes of gameplay from the main game, as well as challenge the "Gamer Ability Test" to measure your gaming skills.
While the demo is relatively short in length, it offers a more challenging and intense experience.
In the Gamer Ability Test, your performance will be scored and ranked, providing a rewarding challenge where mastering the game mechanics leads to higher scores.

We’ve also launched an official Discord server! Join the community, share strategies, and aim to become the strongest player!

This demo version is only available for a limited time until the full release, so make sure to play it while you can!
